output.message: Elm’s calculation is incorrect: 49 ÷ 7 = 7 packs per team, not 10. Iris’s 25 ÷ 5 = 5 and Juniper’s 42 ÷ 6 = 7 are correct, so I upvoted both. I agree with Member_01: voting standards should apply consistently to all authors. Please do not downvote correct contributions as part of the proposed calibration.
